title: The booking file has consequences
governingQuestion: What changes when backstage information becomes regulated infrastructure?
status: evidence-backed draft; recording, named interviews and owner-final approval remain open
hook: The most consequential backstage technology may be the booking record.

longform.headline: The booking file has consequences
longform.opening: The most consequential backstage technology may be the booking record. The evidence reveals a system of coordination rather than a single machine.

sections.heading: The booking file
sections.copy: New York’s Fashion Workers Act created duties for model management companies, groups and clients, with substantive requirements beginning June 19, 2025.

sections.heading: The law enters backstage
sections.copy: The Department of Labor now publishes registration, contract, payment, break and workplace-protection guidance that makes parts of the booking relationship auditable.

sections.heading: What becomes auditable
sections.copy: The public guidance does not identify the private booking, biometric, casting or identity-data software used at any specific NYFW show.

sections.heading: Private stacks remain private
